item.title: West Virginia Department of Environmental Protection now accepting registrations for 2026 Vernal Pool Monitoring Workshops
item.description: West Virginia (WOAY) The West Virginia Department of Environmental Protection (DEP) is accepting registrations for the 2026 Vernal Pool Monitoring Workshops starting in February.
